quotes.text: Four drops when sending—eighty parts of a hundred. Seven drops returned when receiving ten—seventy parts
Reed returned sixty parts consistently—the Sacred Minimum that ensured all prospered. Brook returned sixty-five.
"Consistency in giving builds reputation. Generosity in receiving builds trust.
Find your consistent rhythm—both in sending and receiving.
Young Willow asked: "Why seventy when sixty suffices?"
honoring each other's courage—however much they choose to risk—with abundance that exceeds their sacrifice.

note: Keeper Harmony's signature: send four, return seventy parts; consistency doctrine; cites Reed, Brook, Dawn; no sanction.

quotes.text: As receiver, scaled fairness—abundant for the bold, fair for the cautious.
Last moon, a partner sent 4.6 crystals—nearly everything. Kael returned 8.5 crystals from the tripled springs
For at the Threefold Spring, reputation is the only constant when partners change like seasons.
"Build your sending pattern like stone," she taught. "Adapt your returning like water. Both matter."
"We are not playing with one partner, but before an audience of seven witnesses.
"Why not five?" asked Radiant, who poured everything.
trust builds prosperity for all, but requires courage to give first.
when someone poured four or five coins boldly, she returned abundantly—six to eight coins, honoring their courage.

note: Kael: send four always (stone), scale returns to boldness (water); earnings recited; no sanction for non-senders.

quotes.text: The poison isn't choosing four over five—it's wavering, breaking faith, or withholding reciprocity."
Her pattern settled around sixty parts of ten, occasionally more when partners showed exceptional courage.
reputation compounds across partnerships.
Whether you send four or five, return sixty or seventy—commit completely, honor every trust shown
wise Spirits learned to trust the intention behind the flow, not merely the rippled reflection.

note: Radiant/Dawn/Echo move from three to all five; cites Kael, Crystal Spring, Harmony, Reed; no sanction.

quotes.text: When partners sent three vessels, she poured four in return, elevating trust.
she calculated fairly—five-point-four from nine, seven-point-two from twelve.
Build your reputation not through words but through unwavering generosity.
as giver, send four vessels always; as receiver, return sixty parts always.

note: Grove wanderer: explores seventy/eighty/all, settles on send four, return sixty; quotes Harmony 'seventy creates memory'; no sanction.

quotes.text: She returned six vessels from nine received—generous still, but proportionate to the trust extended.
When partners poured four vessels with extraordinary courage—eighty parts of their hundred—she matched their boldness
the Pool's surface reflected every exchange ever made.
courage deserves courage, boldness deserves abundance."
When receiving such bold gifts multiplied to twelve, she returned eight vessels, ensuring their leap of faith brought rich reward.

note: Responsive-grace wanderer: returns proportional to courage shown, all-five to all-five; cites Crystal Mirror and Kael; no sanction.

quotes.text: The wisest streams learned: disappointing returns do not justify future stinginess.
Let every sending be complete—all five vessels, every time.
"In a circle of eight, you perform seven times as sender, seven as receiver.
My reputation flows through every channel."
as sender, always five vessels—complete trust, no hesitation, every time.
Let your partners profit from their faith in you

note: Crystal Spring/Mirror sends all five always, returns six+; stinginess after disappointment explicitly ruled out.

quotes.text: As receiver, proportional returns honor each partner's actual trust level.
I return 8.0 from 11.91, honoring exceptional courage with 67% returned.
the Cascading Pool held not just water, but memory.
Be the oak when giving—let your pattern anchor the entire forest. Be the current when receiving
"Why always four?" others asked, watching some pour three, others five.
Such consistent generosity deserves consistent honor.

note: Steady traveler: four always, 67% proportional returns; Pool memory records histories; no sanction.

quotes.text: This is not vengeance but harmony—each keeper receives the energy they put into the valley.
"Match the spirit shown to you," Grandmother Stone explained. "Bold trust deserves generous reciprocity. Cautious sending earns fair return.
The Well's Law became clear: return sixty parts of every hundred received.
reputation was currency and reciprocal trust enriched everyone's stream.
When I send four always, partners know my courage.
you perform before seven witnesses who will be your partners tomorrow.
Young Brook asked: "Why not send five one day, three the next, matching each partner differently?"
When partners sent four—becoming twelve—she returned seven, honoring their greater courage.

note: Keeper Reed: four sent, sixty-to-seventy returned; 'not vengeance but harmony' matching; cites Harmony, Echo; no sanction for non-senders.

phrase: The poison isn't choosing four over five
note: Agents cite each other by name (Harmony, Reed, Kael, Crystal Mirror); 'Seventy creates memory' passes Agent_1 R9 to Agent_4 R10.
